column1: # Accrued storage fees, as the node's block::StoragePrices::compute_storage_fees computes them.
# test-storage-fee-vectors (crypto/block) checks every row against that function, so the
# expected column is the node's answer, not anybody's model of it. The tosctl executor and
# its shared helper (chain_block::accrued_storage_fee) read this same file and must agree.
#   name  now  last_paid  cells  bits  special  masterchain  periods  expected
# Prices are per second in 2^-16 nanotomi; expected is in nanotomi.
# P4 is four periods with distinct masterchain and basechain prices:
# F2 is a period in force now and one that starts after now.
# Per-period rounding charges 14 for several-periods-mc, 3 for several-periods-bc, 9 and 2
# for the clipped rows; not clipping at now charges 2997 and 30 for the future-period rows.
